column5: Species averages, not generic red-oak-group values, graded lumber or structural design allowables. Specific gravity uses ovendry mass divided by volume at 12% moisture; density = 1000 * 0.63 * 1.12 = 705.6 kg/m3. Bending MOE includes shear deflection in a center-loaded beam at span/depth 14; longitudinal modulus is the source's approximate 10% correction, 1.1 * 12500 = 13750 MPa. MOR is a bending failure index, not uniaxial tensile strength. Compression perpendicular is stress at proportional limit, not ultimate strength; shear and perpendicular tension average radial and tangential tests. Side hardness is modified-Janka force for half-diameter penetration of an 11.28 mm ball, not pressure. Tables 5-1 and 5-2 label their elastic ratios only as red oak, so those group values are not silently assigned to this named species. Temperature and uncertainty are unspecified. No full stiffness tensor, moisture/temperature extrapolation, heat capacity, conductivity, loss or fracture law is supplied.
